outline.unique_angle: Every 'kill your side project' post online cites markets, motivation, or sunk cost. None cover a hard regulatory wall where the project legally cannot exist no matter how good the idea is. This post is told from a dual RN + indie-dev seat, grounds the kill decision in specific AU law (Privacy Act 1988, APP 3/6) and a real PMS vendor ToS — not US HIPAA — making it the only AU-specific dev diary on 'a rule that means the project cannot exist.'
